list.name: LoadId
list.label: Lote
list.query: select LoadId from TestLoad where Status = 'Succeeded' order by CreatedAt desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia visible para interpretar los cuadros ejecutivos de capacidad.

options.content:
### Que muestra
Este tablero resume capacidad para toma de decision: estado general, top 5 riesgos, forecast 30/60/90, headroom y recomendaciones.

### Como interpretarlo
Critical requiere accion inmediata; Warning requiere plan preventivo; OK indica que no hay riesgo relevante en los datos cargados. Si un cuadro no muestra datos, significa que falta informacion para el rango o lote seleccionado, no que el estado sea OK.

### Accion sugerida
Priorizar primero los recursos con menor headroom, menor DaysToSaturation y recomendaciones High.

panels.title: Overall Capacity State
panels.description: Resumen ejecutivo de decision calculado desde riesgos de capacidad del lote seleccionado. SIN DATOS significa que el filtro no encontro evidencia.

targets.rawSql: with Riesgos as (select OverallRisk from RiskAssessment where RiskAssessmentId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})'), Kpis as (select P95Utilization, HeadroomAvailable from CapacityKpi where coalesce(LoadId, substring(CapacityKpiId from '^(.+)-Kpi-')) ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})') select case when (select count(*) from Riesgos) = 0 and (select count(*) from Kpis) = 0 then 'SIN DATOS' when exists (select 1 from Riesgos where OverallRisk = 'Critical') or exists (select 1 from Kpis where P95Utilization >= 85 or HeadroomAvailable <= 15) then 'CRITICAL' when exists (select 1 from Riesgos where OverallRisk = 'Warning') or exists (select 1 from Kpis where P95Utilization >= 75 or HeadroomAvailable <= 25) then 'WARNING' else 'OK' end as State

panels.title: Top 5 Capacity Risks
panels.description: Top 5 services or resources that need executive prioritization.

targets.rawSql: with Riesgos as (select coalesce(mr.Name, r.ScopeId) as HostName, coalesce(srm.ServiceId, etc.BusinessServiceId) as ServiceId, r.OverallRisk, r.Reason, r.CalculatedAt, case r.OverallRisk when 'Critical' then 3 when 'Warning' then 2 else 1 end as Priority from RiskAssessment r left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = r.ScopeId left join ServiceResourceMap srm on srm.ResourceId = r.ScopeId and srm.MapId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent etc on etc.ComponentName = mr.Name and etc.LoadId = substring(r.RiskAssessmentId from '^(.+)-Risk-') where r.RiskAssessmentId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})'), Kpis as (select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, coalesce(srm.ServiceId, etc.BusinessServiceId) as ServiceId, case when k.P95Utilization >= 85 or k.HeadroomAvailable <= 15 then 'Critical' when k.P95Utilization >= 75 or k.HeadroomAvailable <= 25 then 'Warning' else 'OK' end as OverallRisk, 'Capacidad ' || k.MetricName || ': P95=' || round(k.P95Utilization, 2) || ' Headroom=' || round(k.HeadroomAvailable, 2) as Reason, k.CalculatedAt, case when k.P95Utilization >= 85 or k.HeadroomAvailable <= 15 then 3 when k.P95Utilization >= 75 or k.HeadroomAvailable <= 25 then 2 else 1 end as Priority from CapacityKpi k left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId left join ServiceResourceMap srm on srm.ResourceId = k.ResourceId and srm.MapId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent etc on etc.ComponentName = mr.Name and etc.LoadId = coalesce(k.LoadId, substring(k.CapacityKpiId from '^(.+)-Kpi-')) where coalesce(k.LoadId, substring(k.CapacityKpiId from '^(.+)-Kpi-')) ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})') select HostName, ServiceId, OverallRisk, Reason, CalculatedAt from (select * from Riesgos union all select * from Kpis) Datos where OverallRisk in ('Warning','Critical') order by Priority desc, CalculatedAt desc limit 5

panels.title: Capacity Used Vs Headroom
panels.description: Decision view of used capacity and remaining headroom. Missing data means no KPI evidence for the selected range.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, k.MetricName, k.AverageUtilization as UsedPercent, k.PeakUtilization, k.P95Utilization, k.HeadroomAvailable as AvailablePercent from CapacityKpi k left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by k.HeadroomAvailable asc, k.CalculatedAt desc limit 10

panels.title: Forecast 30/60/90 Days
panels.description: Forecast windows and days-to-saturation for investment and remediation decisions.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, f.ResourceId) as HostName, f.MetricName, f.Forecast30Days, f.Forecast60Days, f.Forecast90Days, f.DaysToSaturation, f.Confidence from ForecastResult f left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = f.ResourceId where f.ForecastResultId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by f.DaysToSaturation asc, f.CalculatedAt desc limit 20

panels.title: Recommendations
panels.description: Acciones priorizadas por host. SIN DATOS significa que no hay recomendaciones abiertas para el lote seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, rec.ScopeId) as HostName, rec.Priority, rec.Action, rec.Reason, rec.Status from Recommendation rec left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = rec.ScopeId where rec.RecommendationId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and rec.Status = 'Open' order by case rec.Priority when 'High' then 3 when 'Medium' then 2 when 'Low' then 1 else 0 end desc, HostName limit 20

panels.title: Monthly Growth And Baseline
panels.description: Executive trend context for growth and deviation from baseline.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(mr.Name, k.ResourceId) as HostName, k.MetricName, k.MonthlyGrowthRate, k.BaselineDelta, k.HeadroomAvailable from CapacityKpi k left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = k.ResourceId where k.CapacityKpiId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by k.MonthlyGrowthRate desc, k.CalculatedAt desc limit 20
